08 Admin & SOAP Registry
item.description: M3 verification through the legacy SOAP Business Registry (the registry service must be running). T14 checks the seeded ACTIVE SEC number of employer2@ (Kalinga Foods); the admin then approves and removes the verification, and employer2@ re-saves the company so it is back in the queue (re-runnable). T15 uses a throwaway employer with a random number (NOT_FOUND). A wrong SOAP password (502 REGISTRY_AUTH_FAILED) cannot be caused from Postman – it is covered by the Core PHPUnit tests (tests/Feature/Registry).
